sentences.text:
Ramlal S/o Sh. Fakira Ram, B/c Brahmin, R/o Himatsar, Tehsil Nokha, District Bikaner (Raj.) (Presently Lodged in Sub-Jail,
Ratangarh)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State of Rajasthan Through Public Prosecutor.

----Respondent _____________________________________________________ For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Bajrang Lal, (petitioner's brother),
 present in person For Respondent(s) : Mr. AS Rathore, PP _____________________________________________________  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Judgment / Order 22/05/2018

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.118/2018 of Police Station Ratangarh, District Churu, for the offence punishable under Sections 419, 420, 272, 273 of IPC and Sections 104, 106 and 107 of the Trademark Act and Sections 51, 52 and 59 of the Food Standard & Safety Act.
He has preferred this bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

Mr. Bajrang Lal, (petitioner's brother), appears on behalf of the petitioner submits that the accused-petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficient long time to be concluded.
Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.

[CRLMB-4674/2018] Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it just and proper to grant bail to the accused petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

Accordingly, the bail application filed under Sec.439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that petitioner Ramlal S/o Sh. Fakira Ram, shall be released on bail in connection with FIR No.118/2018 of Police Station Ratangarh, District Churu, provided he executes a personal bond in a sum of Rs.80,000/- with two sound and solvent sureties of Rs.40,000/- each to the satisfaction of learned trial court for his appearance before that court on each and every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till the completion of the trial.
